category: Devices for Measuring or Indicating Time of Day/Short Durations
explanation: Sundial, Hourglass, Grandfather Clock, and Stopwatch are all devices primarily used to measure or indicate the time within a day or specific short durations. A Calendar organizes time over days, weeks, and months, but does not indicate the current hour or minute.
Four of these were wonders of the ancient world that have been completely destroyed. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original Seven Wonders still largely intact today.

category: Plural Nouns for Single, Dual-Part Objects
explanation: Scissors, Trousers, Glasses, and Pliers are all words that are grammatically plural but refer to a single object made of two corresponding parts. 'Shirt' is a singular noun and refers to a single, non-dual object.
